title: Verify: Background layer and chair/wardrobe assets resolve with matching dimensions unit tests
description: Add a test reading the real manifest and SVG files for the six new ids, checking existence, dimensions and colour variety.

steps.action: Model on game/tests/publicAssetSvgs.test.ts: read manifest.json via fileURLToPath(new URL('../public/assets', import.meta.url)). For ids background:wall, background:floor, background:window-view, background:lighting, furniture:chair, furniture:wardrobe assert the entry exists, the file exists, svg width/height regex equals manifest dimensions, and the file contains at least two distinct fill="#..." values.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sg3BackgroundFurniture.test.ts
